headline: Put your startup assumptions to the test.
value_proposition: Explore an AI co-founder concept that helps turn uncertain digital-product ideas into practical validation experiments.
target_audience: Entrepreneurs exploring an early-stage digital product
problem: An idea can sound convincing while its central assumptions still need evidence.
proposed_solution: Investigate the idea, challenge unsupported assumptions, and prepare an experiment for founder review.
features: Structured hypotheses and customer-discovery interview guides
Explicit proposed success criteria and evidence that could weaken a hypothesis
Local concept pages with founder approval before generation
